== Monster tokens ==

Some targets on the battlefield may drop special items or tokens. They grant useful bonuses when cubed with the class charm you picked up in Kurast 3000 BA. See [[Level ubers#Kurast 3000 BA|Kurast 3000 BA]] if you do not have it yet.

== Veteran tokens ==

In '''Terror and Destruction''' difficulty, you can find '''veteran monsters''' near the end of each Act. There are 5 types of veteran monsters, one for each Act. Kill them on '''Terror''' difficulty to receive an 'Evil Eye' token.

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/highlights/veteran.gif -->

Cube your class charm with five tokens to receive additional bonuses.

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/highlights/veteran_item.gif -->

'''Veterans'''<br> ''Act 1 : Clawstorm Terror<br> Act 2 : Fairy Witch<br> Act 3 : Glowing Blob<br> Act 4 : Landmass<br> Act 5 : Bane Hunter''

[Class Charm] + the correct 5 tokens -> returns [Class Charm] with added bonuses

''This upgrade recipe adds the following bonuses:''

+1 to [Your class] Skill Levels<br> +20% to Experience Gained<br>

== Act boss tokens ==

On '''Terror or Destruction''' difficulty, kill '''Act bosses''' to receive a 'Dogma' token. Collect each of the five tokens, plus two extra tokens corresponding to one of the Prime Evils (Mephisto, Diablo or Baal).

Then cube the tokens to receive a Signet of Skill. The Signet can be consumed to gain 1 skill point. You can only use 3 of these signets on any given character.

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/highlights/skillsignet_item.gif -->

Required tokens (7) -> Signet of Skill
